headline: National Development Fund: Projects worth 10 billion euros – Plans for PYRKAL and Korydallos Prisons
summary: Projects worth 10 billion euros are planned through the National Development Fund, including prison projects, and 2 billion euros will be returned to the ESM, according to deputy managing director Panagiotis Stampoulidis.
why: The National Development Fund channels public investment and EU-linked funds in Greece, and repayments to the European Stability Mechanism affect the country's debt obligations.
